branches.gstinFormHelp: Type the details exactly as on the GST registration certificate. The number can't change once saved; every change is kept in the transaction log.

f.einvoiceHint: Tick when the CA confirms e-invoicing applies to this GSTIN.
f.codeHelp: 2–12 capitals, digits or dashes, used in IDs. Can't change later.
f.name: Name
f.gstinOnBranchHelp: The registration this place of business sits under.
f.placeCodeHelp: 2–12 capitals, digits or dashes, unique in the company. Can't change later.

err.gstin: A GSTIN is 15 characters, e.g. 2 digits, a PAN, a digit or letter, Z and a check character.
err.gstinPan: Characters 3 to 12 must be the company's PAN {{pan}}.
err.code: Use 2–12 capital letters, digits or dashes.
err.name: Enter the name.

rules.title: Sending stock between your GSTINs
rules.m1: Between places on the same GSTIN
rules.d1: Delivery challan; e-way bill above the limit
rules.o1: Not a sale: stock moves within the same registration
rules.m2: To another GSTIN of the company
rules.d2: Tax invoice with IGST (CGST and SGST when both are in the same state); e-way bill above the limit
rules.o2: The receiving GSTIN makes its purchase entry and takes the GST credit
rules.d3: Tax invoice for the goods sent back, or a credit note
rules.n1: Under GST each registration is a separate person, so stock moving between them is billed with tax, though the money stays in one company.
rules.n2: When the receiving place can take the full GST credit, the value on the invoice is accepted.
rules.n3: In the company's own accounts these are branch transfers, not sales: profit counts only when the goods are sold outside.
rules.n4: Stock shows as in transit until the receiving place confirms it.
